{{Top|leg}}
'''Stellar dust clouds''', also simply known as '''dust clouds''', were a type of stellar phenomena encountered in [[Realspace|space]].<ref name="SHIPSGALAXY">''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]''</ref> Dust clouds rendered [[Ray shield/Legends|ray]] and [[Particle shield/Legends|particle]] shields inoperable, and blinded [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] - though otherwise did not cause damage.<ref name="SHIPSGALAXY">''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
